say:4:1131011003:1.text: It didn't look like any animal I've ever seen. Its entire body was pitch black as if it had just crawled out of some dark underground world.
say:4:1131011003:1.source_cn: 它不像野兽，全身的颜色都很深，我觉得是它从黑漆漆的地底...

say:5:1131011004:1.text: Yes, dark like a moonless night! And it came and went like a shadow.
